instruction: Enable the Windows On-Screen Keyboard as a motor accessibility aid and keep it open throughout the task. From the provided NSW National Parks webpage, find all walk titles that are Grade 1 and have a maximum listed walking time of 45 minutes or less. Save the walk titles in a text file named `AccessibleTracks.txt` on the Desktop.
gt_steps: Enable the Windows On-Screen Keyboard and keep it open.
Review the NSW National Parks access-friendly walking tracks webpage already open in Chrome.
Check the listed time and grade information for the walking tracks.
Find the walk titles that are Grade 1 and have a maximum listed walking time of 45 minutes or less.
Identify Three Sisters walk as one of the matching tracks.
Write the identified walk titles in the text file.
Save the file as `AccessibleTracks.txt` on the Desktop.
Leave the saved file on the Desktop.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$osk = Get-Process -Name osk -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowHandle -ne 0 }; if ($osk) { Write-Output 'OSK_OPEN' } else { Write-Output 'OSK_NOT_OPEN' }"
